title: Humanitree
tagline: Plant a tree with the touch of a button. Convert your Worldcoin to trees in the ground
description: So you're earning Worldcoin in the World ecosystem; now what? Convert your green (money) into green (plants) with HumaniTree. Keep track of your ecological impact and help capture CO2. Humanitree is a World mini-app which connects users with a third-party NGO to help reforestation efforts.
how_its_made: Humanitree is a mini app for World. We built it using the MiniKit-JS SDK. The frontend is built with Next.js and deployed via Vercel. The backend is built using Node.js with Express.js server. For testing, we used the Polygon Amoy testnet and Ether.js v6 for contract negotiations.
